intro.hr: Trinaest stilskih slika: šest za mirnu večer i sedam za kavu, po jedna za svaku pripremu. Nisu popis boca i cigara, nego način razmišljanja o težini, slatkoći, dimu, kiselini i tempu.
intro.en: Thirteen style sketches: six for a quiet evening and seven for coffee, one per preparation. They are not a list of bottles and cigars, but a way to think about weight, sweetness, smoke, acidity and pace.

body.hr:
Ovaj arhetip radi kad večer traži lakoću, ali ne i prazninu. Connecticut pokrov donosi kremu, sijeno, badem i blag cedar, a amontillado odgovara orašastom suhoćom, slanom niti i tihom oksidacijom. Zajedno daju spoj koji ne viče. Najbolji je u prvoj polovici večeri, prije teške hrane ili nakon lagane večere.

Kako se slaže
• Cigara — blaga do srednja snaga, svijetao pokrov i format koji ne traje predugo i ne grije se prebrzo.
• Piće — suh amontillado ili srodan oksidativni sherry, blago ohlađen, u manjoj čaši.
• Most — badem, slan rub, suha kora kruha i drveni tonovi spajaju kremu dima s vinom.
• Tempo — mali gutljaj prije dima, zatim duga pauza; prebrz ritam donosi gorčinu.

Kada ne radi
• Večer koja traži desertni dojam — ovaj spoj tada djeluje prestrogo.
• Cigara s puno papra — uz nju sherry zvuči tanko.
• Prehladno vino — gubi orašasti most koji drži cijeli stol.
body.en:
This archetype works when the evening wants lightness without emptiness. A Connecticut wrapper brings cream, hay, almond and gentle cedar; amontillado answers with nutty dryness, a salty thread and quiet oxidation. Together they make a pairing that does not shout. It is best in the first half of the evening, before heavy food or after a light supper.

How to build it
• Cigar — mild to medium strength, pale wrapper, a format that does not run too long or heat too quickly.
• Drink — dry amontillado or a related oxidative sherry, lightly chilled, in a smaller glass.
• Bridge — almond, salty edge, dry bread crust and wood tones connect the creamy smoke to the wine.
• Pace — a small sip before the smoke, then a long pause; rushing can turn the table bitter.

When it fails
• If you want a dessert impression, it will feel too strict.
• If the cigar carries a lot of pepper, the sherry may seem thin.
• If the wine is too cold, it loses the nutty bridge that holds the table together.

title.hr: Maduro i tawny: tamno, slatko, odmjereno
title.en: Maduro and tawny: dark, sweet, measured

body.hr:
Maduro i tawny porto izgledaju kao očit izbor, ali dobar rezultat traži mjeru. Maduro često nosi kakao, melasu, kavu i vlažnu zemlju, a tawny daje orahe, suho voće, karamelu i toplinu bez grubog alkohola. Cilj nije šećerna bomba, nego tamna slatkoća koja ima rub i dovoljno kiseline.

Kako se slaže
• Cigara — srednje do puno tijelo, zreliji tamni pokrov i manje agresivna snaga nego što boja obećava.
• Piće — tawny porto s naglaskom na orasima i suhom voću, u manjoj mjeri po čaši.
• Most — kakao, prženi lješnjak, datulja i karamela stvaraju zajedničku tamnu jezgru.
• Tempo — gutljaj ostaje manji od dima jer porto lako preuzme glavnu ulogu.

Kada ne radi
• Vrlo nikotinska cigara — uz nju slatkoća postaje ljepljiva.
• Premlad i jednostavno sladak porto — u njemu nestaje orašasti sloj.
• Predugo sjedenje — zadnja trećina postaje teška, pa voda više nije izbor nego uvjet.
body.en:
Maduro and tawny port look obvious, but the good version needs restraint. Maduro often carries cocoa, molasses, coffee and damp earth; tawny brings nuts, dried fruit, caramel and warmth without rough alcohol. The goal is not a sugar bomb, but dark sweetness with an edge and enough acidity.

How to build it
• Cigar — medium to full body, a mature dark wrapper, less aggressive strength than the colour may suggest.
• Drink — tawny port led by nuts and dried fruit, served in a modest pour.
• Bridge — cocoa, roasted hazelnut, date and caramel create a shared dark centre.
• Pace — keep each sip smaller than the smoke; port can easily become the main character.

When it fails
• If the cigar is very nicotine-forward, sweetness can become sticky.
• If the port is young and simply sweet, the nutty layer disappears.
• If the pairing runs too long, the final third may feel heavy; water is essential.

title.hr: Jamajka esteri i puniji pokrov: voćna buka pod kontrolom
title.en: Jamaican esters and a fuller wrapper: controlled fruit noise

body.hr:
Jamajčanski esteri mogu značiti bananu, ananas, lak, maslinu, melasu i visoke tonove koji plešu iznad čaše. Puniji pokrov daje zemlju, kakao, papar i strukturu. Dobar stol nastaje kad se rum ne pokušava ukrotiti, nego dobije cigaru dovoljno široku da ga primi bez borbe.

Kako se slaže
• Cigara — srednje puno tijelo, habano ili tamniji pokrov te dovoljno cedra i zemlje da drži ritam.
• Piće — jamajčanski stil s jasnim esterima, po mogućnosti s kapljicom vode ako alkohol nosi previše visine.
• Most — melasa, prezrelo voće, koža, kakao i začin povezuju voćnu aromu s punijim dimom.
• Tempo — prvo ide miris ruma, zatim dim; kad spoj krene preglasno, voda između vraća nepce.

Kada ne radi
• Blaga i kremasta cigara — rum je pregazi.
• Pretopao rum — esteri tada djeluju kao otapalo, a ne kao voće.
• Puno papra s obje strane — stol postaje napet umjesto energičan.
body.en:
Jamaican esters can mean banana, pineapple, varnish, olive, molasses and high tones dancing above the glass. A fuller wrapper gives earth, cocoa, pepper and structure. The table works when the rum is not tamed, but given a cigar broad enough to receive it without a fight.

How to build it
• Cigar — medium-full body, habano or darker wrapper, enough cedar and earth to hold the rhythm.
• Drink — Jamaican style with clear esters, with a drop of water if the alcohol carries too much height.
• Bridge — molasses, overripe fruit, leather, cocoa and spice connect the fruity aroma to fuller smoke.
• Pace — nose the rum first, then smoke; if it gets too loud, water between steps resets the palate.

When it fails
• If the cigar is mild and creamy, the rum will run over it.
• If the rum is served too warm, esters can read as solvent rather than fruit.
• If both sides carry heavy pepper, the table becomes tense, not energetic.

title.en: Agricole and citrus: the green edge

body.hr:
Agricole stil donosi travu, svježu trsku, bijeli papar i mineralnost. Uz citrus ne tražiš koktel od soka, nego aromatski smjer: koricu limete, grejp, malo svježine u posluživanju i cigaru koja se ne boji zelenog ruba. Ovaj arhetip čisti nepce i dobro radi kad je večer topla ili hrana masnija.

Kako se slaže
• Cigara — svjetliji do srednji pokrov, biljni ili cedrov profil, bez previše kakaa i melase.
• Piće — agricole rum, čist ili s vrlo jednostavnim citrusnim naglaskom koji ne skriva destilat.
• Most — trava, limetina korica, bijeli papar, svjež badem i suh cedar.
• Tempo — piće stoji hladnije od teških destilata, ali ne ledeno, jer aroma mora ostati čitljiva.

Kada ne radi
• Vrlo slatka ili tamna cigara — citrus uz nju zvuči odvojeno.
• Citrus koji dominira — spoj se pretvara u napitak uz cigaru, a ne u razgovor.
• Zimska, kožna večer — za nju je ovaj stol previše živahan.
body.en:
Agricole style brings grass, fresh cane, white pepper and minerality. With citrus, the goal is not juice, but direction: lime zest, grapefruit, a little freshness in service and a cigar that is not afraid of a green edge. This archetype cleans the palate and works well on warm evenings or with richer food.

How to build it
• Cigar — pale to medium wrapper, herbal or cedar profile, without too much cocoa or molasses.
• Drink — agricole rum, neat or with a very simple citrus accent that does not hide the spirit.
• Bridge — grass, lime peel, white pepper, fresh almond and dry cedar.
• Pace — serve it cooler than heavy spirits, but not icy; the aroma must remain readable.

When it fails
• If the cigar is very sweet or dark, citrus can sound detached.
• If citrus dominates, the pairing becomes a drink beside a cigar, not a conversation.
• If you want a wintery leather impression, this table may feel too lively.

title.hr: Treset i jaka kubanka: dim protiv dima
title.en: Peat and a strong Cuban: smoke against smoke

body.hr:
Ovo je večer za oprezne korake. Tresetni whisky nosi dim, jod, pepeo, more i ulje, a jača kubanska cigara donosi zemlju, kožu, papar i zgusnutu drvenu gorčinu. Uspjeh nije u tome da jedna strana pobijedi drugu, nego da dimovi imaju različit oblik: jedan morski i hladan, drugi topao i zemljan.

Kako se slaže
• Cigara — puna ili jača, ali dobro odležana, s ravnim gorenjem i bez vlažne grubosti.
• Piće — tresetni stil s kapljicom vode, u manjoj mjeri i bez najjače boce na početku.
• Most — pepeo, koža, sol, tamni kruh, star hrast i zemlja.
• Tempo — jedna trećina cigare zna biti dovoljna za glavni test, pa cijela večer nije obveza.

Kada ne radi
• Mlada i amonijačna cigara — treset joj podcrta manu.
• Whisky visokog alkohola bez vode — nepce se brzo umori.
• Gosti koji nisu navikli na dim — ovaj arhetip tada zatvara stol umjesto da ga otvori.
body.en:
This is an evening for careful steps. Peated whisky carries smoke, iodine, ash, sea and oil; a stronger Cuban cigar can bring earth, leather, pepper and concentrated woody bitterness. Success is not one side defeating the other, but the smokes having different shapes: one maritime and cold, the other warm and earthy.

How to build it
• Cigar — full or strong, but well rested, with even burn and without damp harshness.
• Drink — peated style with a drop of water, a modest pour and not the strongest glass at the start.
• Bridge — ash, leather, salt, dark bread, old oak and earth.
• Pace — one third of the cigar may be enough for the main test; the whole evening does not need forcing.

When it fails
• If the cigar is young and ammoniac, peat will underline the flaw.
• If the whisky is high proof without water, the palate tires quickly.
• If guests are not used to smoke, this archetype closes the table instead of opening it.

title.hr: Espresso i kratka vitola: završni akord
title.en: Espresso and a short vitola: the closing chord

body.hr:
Nije svaka večer za dugo sjedenje. Espresso i kratka vitola daju završni akord: zgusnuto, toplo, jasno i dovoljno kratko da ne razbije san. Kava donosi gorčinu, kremu, pržene note i malo kiseline, a kratka cigara traži pažljivo paljenje jer nema mnogo prostora za ispravak.

Kako se slaže
• Cigara — kratak format, blaga do srednja snaga za radni dan; puniji format ima smisla samo nakon jela.
• Piće — espresso ili ristretto bez puno mlijeka; šećer ulazi u igru samo kao svjestan most.
• Most — kava, kakao, tost, lješnjak, krema i blag drveni ton.
• Tempo — cigara se nakon paljenja prvo smiri, a espresso ide u dva do tri mala gutljaja.

Kada ne radi
• Spaljena kava — cijeli spoj djeluje grubo.
• Prekratka i prejaka vitola — nikotin stiže prije okusa.
• Večer za dugu meditaciju — ovaj arhetip je za nju prekratak i previše konačan.
body.en:
Not every evening is made for a long seat. Espresso and a short vitola give a closing chord: concentrated, warm, clear and short enough not to break sleep. Coffee brings bitterness, crema, roasted notes and a little acidity; a short cigar needs careful lighting because it leaves little room for correction.

How to build it
• Cigar — short format, mild to medium strength for a weekday, or a fuller format only after food.
• Drink — espresso or ristretto without much milk; sugar only if you use it as a deliberate bridge.
• Bridge — coffee, cocoa, toast, hazelnut, crema and a gentle wood tone.
• Pace — let the cigar settle after lighting; drink the espresso in two or three small steps.

When it fails
• If the coffee is scorched, the whole pairing feels rough.
• If the vitola is both very short and very strong, nicotine arrives before flavour.
• If the goal is long meditation, this archetype is too cut and final.

title.en: Espresso: a dense cup, a full cigar

body.hr:
Espresso je najgušća šalica koju ćeš popiti: kratka ekstrakcija, teško tijelo, gorčina i krema. Takva kava ne trpi blagu cigaru — pregazi je prije trećeg dima. Zato ide uz puni nikaragvanski ili honduraški blend, habano ili corojo pokrov, snage četiri i više.

Kako se slaže
• Cigara — puno tijelo, tamniji pokrov, format koji drži sat vremena bez pregrijavanja.
• Piće — espresso ili ristretto, crema svijetla i nespaljena; šećer samo ako svjesno gradiš most.
• Most — kakao, prženi kruh, tamna zemlja i papar drže istu liniju u šalici i u dimu.
• Tempo — dva do tri mala gutljaja kroz prvu trećinu, dalje voda; espresso se pije prije nego se ohladi.

Kada ne radi
• Blaga Connecticut cigara — od nje ostane samo drvo pod gorčinom kave.
• Spaljena crema — gorčina se zbroji s nikotinom i večer stane.
• Prazan želudac — ova kombinacija najbrže pokaže da si preskočio večeru.
body.en:
Espresso is the densest cup you will drink: short extraction, heavy body, bitterness and crema. Such coffee does not tolerate a mild cigar — it runs it over before the third puff. So it goes with a full Nicaraguan or Honduran blend, habano or corojo wrapper, strength four and up.

How to build it
• Cigar — full body, darker wrapper, a format that holds an hour without overheating.
• Drink — espresso or ristretto, crema pale and unburnt; sugar only if you build the bridge on purpose.
• Bridge — cocoa, toasted bread, dark earth and pepper keep the same line in the cup and in the smoke.
• Pace — two or three small sips through the first third, water after that; espresso is drunk before it cools.

When it fails
• A mild Connecticut cigar — only wood is left under the coffee's bitterness.
• Burnt crema — bitterness adds to nicotine and the evening stops.
• An empty stomach — this pairing is the quickest to show you skipped dinner.

body.hr:
Lungo je espresso pušten predugo: više vode, tanje tijelo, ali i više gorčine i pepela iz zadnjeg dijela ekstrakcije. Tražiš cigaru koja tu gorčinu ne pojačava, nego je pokrije slatkoćom — maduro ili broadleaf srednjeg tijela, snage do tri.

Kako se slaže
• Cigara — srednje tijelo i vidljiva slatkoća pokrova; format oko sat vremena.
• Piće — lungo iz svježeg mljevenca, mlaz zaustavi prije nego postane vodenast.
• Most — karamela, suho voće i kakao spajaju šećer pokrova s prženjem kave.
• Tempo — gutljaj rjeđe nego uz espresso; lungo je veći, pa lakše prekrije dim.

Kada ne radi
• Cigara punog tijela — nadglasa razvodnjenu šalicu i lungo ostane samo topla voda.
• Prepečeno prženje — pepeo iz kave i pepeo iz cigare zbroje se u istu notu.
• Predugo stajanje — ohlađen lungo izgubi slatkoću koja je držala most.
body.en:
A lungo is an espresso pulled too long: more water, thinner body, but also more bitterness and ash from the tail of the extraction. You want a cigar that does not amplify that bitterness but covers it with sweetness — maduro or broadleaf, medium body, strength up to three.

How to build it
• Cigar — medium body and visible wrapper sweetness; a format of about an hour.
• Drink — lungo from freshly ground coffee, stopped before it turns watery.
• Bridge — caramel, dried fruit and cocoa join the wrapper's sugar to the roast.
• Pace — sip less often than with espresso; a lungo is larger and covers the smoke more easily.

When it fails
• A full-bodied cigar — it outshouts the diluted cup and the lungo is left as warm water.
• Over-roasted beans — ash from the coffee and ash from the cigar add up to one note.
• Letting it stand — a cold lungo loses the sweetness that held the bridge.

title.en: Americano: a softer entry, a medium cigar

body.hr:
Americano je espresso razrijeđen vrućom vodom: ista jezgra okusa, ali rastegnuta na šalicu koju piješ dvadeset minuta. To je najlakša kava za ritam uz cigaru jer ne traži da žuriš. Uz nju stoji srednja cigara sa začinjenim pokrovom — Cameroon ili blaži habano, snage do tri.

Kako se slaže
• Cigara — srednje tijelo, začinski pokrov, format koji traje koliko i šalica.
• Piće — espresso pa vruća voda, ne obrnuto; omjer po ukusu, obično jedan naprama dva.
• Most — orah, začin, suha kora kruha i blag citrus iz kave.
• Tempo — gutljaj nakon svakog drugog povlačenja; ova kombinacija podnosi razgovor.

Kada ne radi
• Prehladna voda — kava postane mlaka i tanka, a dim odjednom zvuči grubo.
• Vrlo jaka cigara — americano nema gustoću da joj odgovori.
• Prevelika šalica — pola je popiješ hladno, pa nestane i most.
body.en:
An americano is espresso let down with hot water: the same flavour core, stretched into a cup you drink over twenty minutes. It is the easiest coffee to pace with a cigar because it never asks you to hurry. Beside it stands a medium cigar with a spicy wrapper — Cameroon or a milder habano, strength up to three.

How to build it
• Cigar — medium body, spicy wrapper, a format that lasts as long as the cup.
• Drink — espresso first, then hot water, not the other way round; roughly one to two.
• Bridge — walnut, spice, dry bread crust and a light citrus note from the coffee.
• Pace — a sip after every second draw; this pairing tolerates conversation.

When it fails
• Water that is not hot enough — the coffee turns lukewarm and thin, and the smoke suddenly sounds coarse.
• A very strong cigar — the americano has no density to answer it.
• Too large a cup — you drink half of it cold and the bridge is gone.

title.hr: Svijetli filter: čajno tijelo, blijedi pokrov
title.en: Light filter: tea-like body, pale wrapper

body.hr:
Svijetli filter — Etiopija, Kenija, Panama — daje čajno tijelo, cvjetnu aromu i živu kiselost. To je najtiša kava u katalogu i traži jednako tihu cigaru: Connecticut ili claro pokrov, snage jedan do dva. Svaka jača cigara pojede je u prvom dimu.

Kako se slaže
• Cigara — blaga snaga, svijetao pokrov, tanji format koji ne daje previše dima odjednom.
• Piće — pour-over ili V60, svijetlo prženje, popij ga dok je topao, ne vruć.
• Most — badem, med, bijeli cvijet i limunova kora prate kremu blagog dima.
• Tempo — dugi razmaci; kiselost čisti nepce pa se cvjetne note vraćaju cijelu šalicu.

Kada ne radi
• Puna cigara — od kave ostane samo kiselina bez arome.
• Prehladna šalica — cvjetni sloj nestane, a ostane samo tanka kiselost.
• Jutro s premalo vremena — ovaj spoj traži da sjedneš, inače nema smisla.
body.en:
A light filter — Ethiopia, Kenya, Panama — gives a tea-like body, floral aroma and lively acidity. It is the quietest coffee in the catalogue and it asks for an equally quiet cigar: Connecticut or claro wrapper, strength one to two. Any stronger cigar eats it on the first puff.

How to build it
• Cigar — mild strength, pale wrapper, a slimmer format that does not deliver too much smoke at once.
• Drink — pour-over or V60, light roast, drunk warm rather than hot.
• Bridge — almond, honey, white blossom and lemon peel follow the cream of a mild smoke.
• Pace — long gaps; the acidity cleans the palate so the floral notes return all cup long.

When it fails
• A full cigar — only acidity without aroma is left of the coffee.
• A cup gone cold — the floral layer disappears and thin sourness remains.
• A morning in a hurry — this pairing asks you to sit down, otherwise there is no point.

title.hr: Tamni filter i french press: zemlja uz zemlju
title.en: Dark filter and french press: earth beside earth

body.hr:
Sumatra, monsunski Malabar i tamna mješavina u french pressu daju gustu, zemljanu šalicu s malo kiseline i puno teksture. To je jedina filter kava koja podnosi cigaru punog tijela: habano, oscuro ili maduro pokrov, snage četiri i više. Zemlja ide uz zemlju.

Kako se slaže
• Cigara — puno tijelo, tamniji pokrov, duži format jer i šalica traje.
• Piće — grubo mljeveno, četiri minute stajanja, ulij polako da talog ostane dolje.
• Most — vlažna zemlja, duhan, drvo i gorka čokolada zajedničke su obje strane.
• Tempo — mirno, s dugim pauzama; gusta kava i gust dim traže zrak između.

Kada ne radi
• Blaga cigara — kava je pregazi bez ostatka.
• Prekuhana kava koja gorči — uz cigaru postaje samo teška.
• Kasni sat uz jak blend — ovo je spoj koji budi, ne uspavljuje.
body.en:
Sumatra, monsooned Malabar and a dark blend in a french press give a thick, earthy cup with little acidity and plenty of texture. It is the only filter coffee that carries a full-bodied cigar: habano, oscuro or maduro wrapper, strength four and up. Earth goes with earth.

How to build it
• Cigar — full body, darker wrapper, a longer format because the cup lasts too.
• Drink — coarse grind, four minutes of steeping, poured slowly so the grounds stay down.
• Bridge — damp earth, tobacco, wood and bitter chocolate belong to both sides.
• Pace — calm, with long pauses; thick coffee and thick smoke need air between them.

When it fails
• A mild cigar — the coffee runs it over completely.
• Over-brewed, bitter coffee — with a cigar it only turns heavy.
• A late hour with a strong blend — this pairing wakes you up, it does not settle you.

title.hr: S mlijekom: krema traži slatki pokrov
title.en: With milk: cream wants a sweet wrapper

body.hr:
Cappuccino, flat white i cortado imaju masnoću i slatkoću mlijeka, a ona zaobli papar i skrati oštre rubove dima. Cijena je da mlijeko skriva fine note, pa cigara mora imati vlastitu slatkoću — Connecticut ili maduro srednjeg tijela, snage dva do tri.

Kako se slaže
• Cigara — srednje tijelo, slatkast pokrov, format koji ne traje puno dulje od šalice.
• Piće — mlijeko pjenjeno do svile, ne do pjene; bez sirupa i bez šećera na vrh.
• Most — krema, lješnjak, kakao i mliječna karamela drže cijelu kombinaciju.
• Tempo — dim vodi, kava prati; gutljaj tek kad se okus dima počne gubiti.

Kada ne radi
• Vrlo blaga cigara — mlijeko je ugasi do trećine.
• Slatki sirupi — od cigare ostane samo topli dim bez okusa.
• Kasna večer — mlijeko je obrok, ne završetak.
body.en:
Cappuccino, flat white and cortado carry the fat and sweetness of milk, and that rounds off pepper and shortens the sharp edges of smoke. The price is that milk hides fine notes, so the cigar must bring sweetness of its own — Connecticut or maduro, medium body, strength two to three.

How to build it
• Cigar — medium body, sweet-leaning wrapper, a format not much longer than the cup.
• Drink — milk steamed to silk, not to foam; no syrup and no sugar on top.
• Bridge — cream, hazelnut, cocoa and milky caramel hold the whole thing together.
• Pace — the smoke leads, the coffee follows; sip only when the smoke's flavour starts to fade.

When it fails
• A very mild cigar — the milk puts it out by the first third.
• Sweet syrups — nothing is left of the cigar but warm smoke.
• Late evening — milk is a meal, not a closing note.

title.hr: Turska iz džezve: talog, šećer i colorado
title.en: Turkish from the džezva: grounds, sugar and colorado

body.hr:
Turska kava kuha se s talogom, pa je gusta, slatkasta i dugo topla. Uz nju najbolje stoji kubanski ili nikaragvanski habano colorado pokrov punog tijela: slatkoća šećera hvata kožu i cedar iz dima, a talog drži teksturu koju blaga cigara ne bi pratila.

Kako se slaže
• Cigara — puno tijelo, colorado ili habano pokrov, format koji traje koliko i razgovor.
• Piće — kuhaj do prve pjene, pa skini; šećer ide u kuhanje, ne poslije.
• Most — koža, cedar, karamela i pečeni šećer spajaju šalicu i dim.
• Tempo — mali gutljaji s vrha, bez taloga; voda uz šalicu je obavezna.

Kada ne radi
• Gutljaj s talogom — grubost ostane na jeziku i pokvari sljedeći dim.
• Blaga cigara — nestane pod slatkoćom i gustoćom.
• Žurba — turska kava traži da sjediš dok se slegne, inače nema ni okusa ni mosta.
body.en:
Turkish coffee is brewed with its grounds, so it is thick, faintly sweet and stays warm for a long time. A full-bodied Cuban or Nicaraguan habano colorado wrapper suits it best: the sugar catches the leather and cedar in the smoke, while the grounds hold a texture a mild cigar could not follow.

How to build it
• Cigar — full body, colorado or habano wrapper, a format that lasts as long as the conversation.
• Drink — brew to the first foam, then lift it off; sugar goes in during brewing, not after.
• Bridge — leather, cedar, caramel and burnt sugar join the cup to the smoke.
• Pace — small sips from the top, never the grounds; water beside the cup is compulsory.

When it fails
• A sip of grounds — the roughness stays on the tongue and spoils the next draw.
• A mild cigar — it disappears under the sweetness and the body.
• Rushing — Turkish coffee asks you to sit while it settles, otherwise there is neither flavour nor bridge.
